title: The 2026-10-25 review omitted the Usage Policy clause on services that route requests through consumer subscriptions, so the record wrongly says pooling is not named
resolution: Deferred to recheck-provider-terms-pages. The clause was on the page before that review: Wayback snapshots of 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-26 carry it. Reported to the owner by the coordinator for D15.

title: The 2026-10-25 review omitted that the Agent SDK overview says the SDK is governed by the Commercial Terms
resolution: Deferred to recheck-provider-terms-pages, which adds the license and terms statement. The section was on the page before that review: Wayback snapshots of 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-24 carry it.

title: The Codex App Server page no longer carries the quoted authentication statement that anchors the strongest OpenAI conclusion
resolution: Declined: the finding is false. Pass 2 checked the live Codex App Server page on 2026-10-27 and found both quoted sentences word for word; pass 1 read a truncated copy. Item 2 pass 2 H1.

title: The 2026-10-25 review omitted the legal and compliance sentence that allows customers to provision their own API keys
resolution: Deferred to recheck-provider-terms-pages, which adds the sentence to the credential storage finding. It was on the page before that review: Wayback snapshots of 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-24 carry it.

title: Design D1 cites the wrong Dockerfile lines for the worker-harnesses stage
resolution: Corrected the citation to Dockerfile lines 72 to 74, where the stage and its environment are.

title: The checkout directory is the harness working directory, but the execution account cannot reach it under the private worker directory
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-git-workspace-with-execution-boundary, which defines per-attempt access for the execution account with a Linux test.

title: The contract does not fix the account and cgroup under which the Git processes of workspace operations run
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-git-workspace-with-execution-boundary, which requires worker identity and the worker home cgroup for every Git process.

title: The contract promises that a run credential is never logged or stored, while G2 redacts no such shape and scrubs no spawn environment
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-scm-port-with-g2-credentials, which names the redaction and scrubbing work that G3 owes for run credentials.

title: The webhook receiver ignores that the G2 installation has no ingress and no TLS
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-scm-port-with-g2-credentials, which names the ingress and TLS items that the webhook endpoint depends on.

title: Several opaque SCM identifiers are parsed as text and accept an empty value
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-scm-port-with-g2-credentials, which parses those fields as non-empty identifiers.

title: The Claude Agent SDK record names 0.3.310 as latest and 35 CLI advisories, while 0.3.311 and a 36th advisory appeared on 2026-10-26
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change refresh-g3-dependency-observations.

title: Mantine 9.7.4 superseded the recorded 9.7.3 on the evaluation date
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change refresh-g3-dependency-observations.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change refresh-g3-dependency-observations.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change refresh-g3-dependency-observations.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-account-pool-signals.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-account-pool-signals; coordinator decision: no separate reset signal, a cooldown ends at its stored time.

title: The promise to continue as soon as another slot is eligible ignores the G2 placement backoff and rotation
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-account-pool-signals.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-account-pool-signals, whose scope includes capacity reservation section 10 and its living spec.

title: Product decisions that change gates, artifacts, or policy are not bound to the G2 launch invalidation protocol
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change bind-product-writers-to-launch-invalidation. Item 8 pass 2 M1 lowers the severity to Medium: the binding protocol exists, a reference and race tests are missing.

title: A finished workflow has no current stage, while the board card requires one
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-product-ports-with-g2-lifecycle.

title: The board and task detail cannot show the scheduling wait or rejecting reason of a task
resolution: Deferred to record-placement-outcome for the G2 record of the placement outcome; its product projection is in align-product-ports-with-g2-lifecycle under item 8 pass 2 M2.

title: The Needs you inbox has no source or answer for execution reconciliation
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-product-ports-with-g2-lifecycle.

title: A withdrawn merge request can show that every gate passed after a gate turned stale
resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-product-ports-with-g2-lifecycle.

title: Design D1 says every decline other than a fleet one backs off, but a rejecting outcome ends the attempt
resolution: Design D1 now limits the backoff to waiting declines and says a rejecting outcome ends the attempt not-started with no retry.

title: The records defer pass 1 H3 although the live Codex App Server page still carries the quoted sentences
resolution: Pass 1 H3 is declined with the live page check of 2026-10-27 and removed from the follow-up.

resolution: Pass 1 H1, H2, and L1 now say the 2026-10-25 review omitted the clauses, with the snapshot dates, and the D15 note follows.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change recheck-provider-terms-pages.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-slot-credential-delivery, which depends on the secrets shape of align-scm-port-with-g2-credentials.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-slot-credential-delivery.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-slot-credential-delivery.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-slot-credential-delivery.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-git-workspace-with-execution-boundary.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change derive-workspace-names-from-task-ids; coordinator decision: encode the names, with no API restriction.

title: Design D1 and D2 name uid 10001 as the Linux worker account, while the worker runs as root
resolution: D1 and D2 now say the Linux worker runs as root under setpriv and owns the data root; uid 10001 is the control plane's.

resolution: Deferred to the follow-up change align-git-workspace-with-execution-boundary.
